info.title: FHIR API
info.description: FHIR R4 and R5 view of the EHR. Sections show who calls each endpoint: payers during CRD, payer DTR apps, and the Payer Gateway (/internal).

tags: 1. FHIR read and search - called by payers (CRD), payer DTR apps and the Payer Gateway
get.summary:
Reads one resource by type and id.
Types: Patient, Coverage, Practitioner, PractitionerRole (id "role-{practitionerId}"), Organization, Location,
ServiceRequest, DeviceRequest, MedicationRequest, Appointment, Encounter, DocumentReference, Binary.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Required. FHIR resource type, case sensitive (e.g. "Patient").

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Required. Resource id (the EHR id), e.g. pat-1, cov-1, ord-1-hd, doc-1-labs.

200.description: The resource as FHIR JSON (content type application/fhir+json), e.g. { "resourceType": "Patient", "id": "pat-1", ... }.

400.description: The resource type is not supported. Body: a FHIR OperationOutcome, e.g. { "resourceType": "OperationOutcome", "issue": [ { "severity": "error", "code": "not-supported", "diagnostics": "Resource type Foo is not supported." } ] }.

404.description: The EHR has no such record. Body: a FHIR OperationOutcome, e.g. { "resourceType": "OperationOutcome", "issue": [ { "severity": "error", "code": "not-found", "diagnostics": "Patient/pat-9 was not found." } ] }.

502.description: The EHR could not be reached or answered with an error. Body: a FHIR OperationOutcome.

tags: 1. FHIR read and search - called by payers (CRD), payer DTR apps and the Payer Gateway

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Required. FHIR resource type, case sensitive (e.g. "Coverage").

parameters.name: _id
parameters.description: One or more ids, comma separated: _id=ord-cpap,ord-visit

parameters.name: patient
parameters.description: Patient id or "Patient/id".

parameters.name: subject
parameters.description: Same as patient (some clients send subject).

parameters.name: beneficiary
parameters.description: Same as patient (Coverage searches may send beneficiary).

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Codes, comma separated, as system|code: http://loinc.org|39156-5

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Observation category, e.g. laboratory or vital-signs.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Lower date bound: date=ge2026-01-01 (only ge/gt are used).

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Coverage status, e.g. active.

parameters.name: clinical-status
parameters.description: Condition clinical status, e.g. active.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: DocumentReference type as system|code: http://loinc.org|18748-4

parameters.name: _include
parameters.description:
Related resources to add to the Bundle, repeatable:
_include=DeviceRequest:patient&_include=DeviceRequest:requester

200.description: A FHIR Bundle of type "searchset" (content type application/fhir+json): total = number of matches, entry = the resources found plus the ones added by _include. Nothing found = total 0 and no entry (still 200).

400.description: The resource type is not supported, or the parameter this type needs (_id or patient) is missing. Body: a FHIR OperationOutcome, e.g. { "resourceType": "OperationOutcome", "issue": [ { "severity": "error", "code": "required", "diagnostics": "Coverage search requires the patient parameter, e.g. Coverage?patient=pat-1." } ] }.

502.description: The EHR could not be reached or answered with an error. Body: a FHIR OperationOutcome.

tags: 2. DTR forms (QuestionnaireResponse) - saved by the Payer Gateway or a payer DTR app
post.summary: Creates a new form. Any id in the body is replaced by a server id. Returns 201 + Location header.
post.description:
Must be filled in the body: resourceType = "QuestionnaireResponse" and subject.reference = "Patient/{patient id}".
The order and the coverage the form is for are read from the DTR "qr-context" extensions, when present.

requestBody.description: Required. A FHIR QuestionnaireResponse (subject = Patient/{id} is required).

201.description: Saved. Body: the form as stored, with its new id; the Location header has its URL.

400.description: The body is not a QuestionnaireResponse, or subject does not point to a patient. Body: a FHIR OperationOutcome, e.g. { "resourceType": "OperationOutcome", "issue": [ { "severity": "error", "code": "required", "diagnostics": "QuestionnaireResponse.subject must reference a Patient, e.g. 'Patient/pat-1'." } ] }.

502.description: The EHR data API could not be reached or answered with an error. Body: a FHIR OperationOutcome.

tags: 2. DTR forms (QuestionnaireResponse) - saved by the Payer Gateway or a payer DTR app
put.summary: Creates (201) or replaces (200) the form with this id. The body id, if present, must equal the URL id.
put.description:
Must be filled in the body: resourceType = "QuestionnaireResponse" and subject.reference = "Patient/{patient id}".
Send the whole form each time: it replaces the stored one.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Required. Form id chosen by the caller, e.g. "qr-frm-235b7ad69e85".

200.description: Replaced. Body: the form as stored.

201.description: Created (the id was new). Body: the form as stored.

400.description: The body is not a QuestionnaireResponse, or subject does not point to a patient, or the id in the body is not the id in the URL. Body: a FHIR OperationOutcome, e.g. { "resourceType": "OperationOutcome", "issue": [ { "severity": "error", "code": "required", "diagnostics": "QuestionnaireResponse.subject must reference a Patient, e.g. 'Patient/pat-1'." } ] }.

502.description: The EHR data API could not be reached or answered with an error. Body: a FHIR OperationOutcome.

tags: 3. SMART launch context - called by payer DTR apps
post.summary:
Exchanges the one-time code for the launch context: patient, encounter, fhirUser, fhirContext (orders, coverage)
and appContext (from the payer's CRD card). The access_token is a random value; no endpoint checks it.

code.description: Required. The code from authorize. It works once only.

redirect_uri.description: The same redirect_uri as in authorize (not checked).

400.description: Wrong grant type, or unknown / used / expired code.

tags: 4. Internal - called by the Payer Gateway only
post.summary:
Issues a short-lived access token for one patient, in the CDS Hooks "fhirAuthorization" shape.
The gateway sends it to the payer inside the CRD hook call, so the payer can read extra data that was not in the
prefetch. The token is issued and kept (ITokenService), but no endpoint of this API checks it: authentication
is added outside this code.

requestBody.description: Required. subject (payer) and patientId must be filled; scope and minutes are optional.

200.description: The token, ready to send as fhirAuthorization.

tags: 4. Internal - called by the Payer Gateway only
post.summary:
Creates a SMART launch context for a DTR app (patient, user, encounter, orders/coverage, appContext).
The gateway then redirects the browser to {DTR app}?iss={iss}&launch={launchId}.
"iss" is the R4 base URL, or the R5 base URL when the request says fhirVersion = "r5".

requestBody.description: Required. patientId must be filled; user, encounter, fhirContext, appContext and fhirVersion are optional.

400.description: patientId is missing, or fhirVersion is not "r4" or "r5".

subject.description: Required. Who will use the token, normally the payer's id.

patientId.description: Required. The only patient the token may read (EHR patient id).

scope.description: SMART scopes, separated by a space. Empty = read access to the patient's data (SmartScopes.PayerDefault).

minutes.description: Token lifetime in minutes, from 1 to 15 (a smaller or larger value is changed to 1 or 15).

AccessTokenRequest.description: Body of POST /internal/access-tokens (sent by the Payer Gateway).

scope.description: The scopes the token was given.

subject.description: Who the token was issued to (the payer id).

patient.description: The patient the token is limited to.

AccessTokenResponse.description:
Response of POST /internal/access-tokens.
Same shape as the CDS Hooks "fhirAuthorization" object, so the Payer Gateway can pass it to the payer unchanged.

reference.description: "Type/id" of a resource the form is for.

FhirContextItem.description: One entry of the SMART "fhirContext" array in the token response.

error.description: Error code, e.g. invalid_request, invalid_grant, unsupported_grant_type.

error_description.description: What went wrong, in plain text.

OAuthError.description: Standard OAuth 2.0 error body returned by the authorize, token and /internal endpoints.

issuer.description: FHIR base URL of this API (the "iss" the app was launched with).

authorization_endpoint.description: Where the app asks for a code.

token_endpoint.description: Where the app exchanges the code for the launch context.

code_challenge_methods_supported.description: PKCE method named for SMART clients (PKCE values are not checked).

scopes_supported.description: Scopes an app may ask for (scopes are not checked).

SmartConfigurationResponse.description: Body of GET /fhir/r4/.well-known/smart-configuration (SMART App Launch discovery document).

patientId.description: Required. Patient the DTR form is for (EHR patient id).

fhirContext.description: References handed to the DTR app as fhirContext: the orders and the coverage the form is for.

appContext.description: appContext from the payer's CRD card (which questionnaires to load, coverage-assertion-id). Passed to the app unchanged.

fhirVersion.description:
FHIR release the DTR app works with: "r4" (default) or "r5". Decides the "iss" returned, i.e. whether the app
reads /fhir/r4 or /fhir/r5.

SmartLaunchRequest.description: Body of POST /internal/smart-launches (sent by the Payer Gateway when a user opens a DTR link).

launchId.description: Opaque launch id the DTR app sends back to /fhir/r4/auth/authorize.

iss.description: FHIR base URL of this API (the SMART "iss").

expiresAt.description: The launch must be used before this time.

SmartLaunchResponse.description:
Response of POST /internal/smart-launches.
The Payer Gateway redirects the browser to {dtrAppUrl}?iss={Iss}&launch={LaunchId}.

access_token.description: A random value. No endpoint of this API checks it.

expires_in.description: Lifetime reported to the app, in seconds.

scope.description: The scopes the app asked for (or the default DTR scopes).

fhirContext.description: Orders and coverage the form is for: [{ "reference": "ServiceRequest/ord-1-hd" }].

appContext.description: appContext from the payer's CRD card.

need_patient_banner.description: Always false: the app must show its own patient banner.

SmartTokenResponse.description: Response of POST /fhir/r4/auth/token: the access token plus the SMART launch context.
